```{r import datasets, include=FALSE}
# Import Luminex Data
  
  table_lum_healthy <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_Healthy_all.xlsx"))  

  table_lum_CarTrans_V0<- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_V0_all.xlsx")) 
   
  table_lum_CarTrans_V1<- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_V1_all.xlsx")) 
  
  table_lum_CarTrans_V2 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_V2_all.xlsx"))
  
  table_lum_CarTrans_V3 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir, "data", "Lum_CarTrans_V3_all.xlsx"))
  
  table_lum_CarTrans_V4 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir,"data", "Lum_CarTrans_V4_all.xlsx"))
  
  table_lum_CarTrans_V5 <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir,"data", "Lum_CarTrans_V5_all.xlsx"))
  
table_lum_CarTrans_VX <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file.path(basedir,"data", "Lum_CarTrans_VX_all.xlsx"))

# Delete ATG_EMB column
table_lum_healthy     <- table_lum_healthy     %>% select(-ATG_EMB1_3)
table_lum_CarTrans_V0 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V0 %>% select(-ATG_EMB1_3)
table_lum_CarTrans_V1 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V1 %>% select(-ATG_EMB1_3)
table_lum_CarTrans_V2 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V2 %>% select(-ATG_EMB1_3)
table_lum_CarTrans_V3 <- table_lum_CarTrans_V3 %>% select(-ATG_EMB1_3)

# Combine Tables
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- rbind(table_lum_CarTrans_V0, table_lum_CarTrans_V1, table_lum_CarTrans_V2, table_lum_CarTrans_V3, table_lum_CarTrans_V4, table_lum_CarTrans_V5, table_lum_healthy, table_lum_CarTrans_VX)%>% 
  mutate(across(-c(Study_ID, Visit), ~ pmax(as.numeric(.), 1))) %>% #sets every value below 1 to 1 because of 0 values
    filter(!Study_ID %in% c("CarTrans-Long-37", "CarTrans-Long-38", "CarTrans-Long-39", "CarTrans-Long-40", "CarTrans-Long-41", "CarTrans-Long-42", "CarTrans-Long-43", "CarTrans-Long-44", "CarTrans-Long-45", "CarTrans-Long-46", "CarTrans-Long-47", "CarTrans-Long-48", "CarTrans-Long-49", "CarTrans-Long-50", "CarTrans-Long-51", "CarTrans-Healthy-29", "CarTrans-Healthy-30", "CarTrans-Healthy-31", "CarTrans-Healthy-32", "CarTrans-Healthy-33", "CarTrans-Healthy-34", "CarTrans-Healthy-35", "CarTrans-Healthy-36", "CarTrans-Healthy-37", "CarTrans-Healthy-38", "CarTrans-Healthy-39", "CarTrans-Healthy-40", "CarTrans-Healthy-41", "CarTrans-Healthy-42", "CarTrans-Healthy-43", "CarTrans-Healthy-44", "CarTrans-Healthy-45", "CarTrans-Healthy-46", "CarTrans-Healthy-47", "CarTrans-Healthy-48","CarTrans-Healthy-49", "CarTrans-Healthy-50")) #Exclude unmeasured samples
```


```{r clean overall table}
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%filter(
    !(Study_ID %in% c("CarTrans-Long-16", "CarTrans-Long-23", "CarTrans-Long-36") &
      str_detect(Visit, "^VX")))%>%
  select(-ISHLT_1990, -ISHLT_2004)
```

# Visualisation

## Abundance bubble plot

```{r abundance bubble plot overall, fig.height=5, fig.width=14}

# Prepare data table for bubble plot
  # Create the loop vector
    parameters <- names(which(sapply(table_lum_CarTrans_overall, is.numeric) == TRUE)) 

  # Prepare data table 
    table_para <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
                  mutate(Visit = case_when(Visit == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
                                           Visit == "V0" ~ "Baseline",
                                           Visit == "V1" ~ "Week 1",
                                           Visit == "V2" ~ "Week 2",
                                           Visit == "V3" ~ "Month 1-3",
                                           Visit == "V4" ~ "Month 4-6",
                                           Visit == "V5" ~ "Month 12",
                                           grepl("^VX", Visit) ~ "Rejection Context",
                                            TRUE ~ as.character(Visit)),
                        Group=ifelse(Visit=="Healthy", "Healthy", "CarTrans")) %>%
                  pivot_longer(cols = where(is.numeric),
                               names_to = "Parameter",
                               values_to = "Parameter_val")
    
# Calculate mean expression for the healthy participants
  healthy_stats <- table_para %>%
                   mutate(Group == "Healthy") %>%
                   group_by(Parameter) %>%
                   summarise(mean_expr_healthy = mean(Parameter_val, na.rm = TRUE))

# Calculate mean expression for CarTrans cohort & calcuate FC
  cohorts_stats <- table_para %>%
                   filter(Group != "Healthy") %>%
                   group_by(Parameter) %>%
                   summarise(mean_expr_group = mean(Parameter_val, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
                   left_join(healthy_stats, by = "Parameter") %>%
                   mutate(log2_fc = log2(mean_expr_group /mean_expr_healthy)) 

  
# Calculate abundance fold change > 1.5 per parameter in CarTrans vs Healthy
  percentage_fc_increase <- table_para %>%
                            filter(Group != "Healthy") %>%
                            group_by(Parameter, Group) %>%
                            left_join(healthy_stats, by = "Parameter") %>%
                            mutate(log2_fc = log2(Parameter_val/mean_expr_healthy)) %>% 
                            mutate(fc_1.5 = log2_fc >1.5) %>%
                            summarise(percentage_fc_1.5 = mean(fc_1.5, na.rm = TRUE) * 100)
  
    # Merge stats tables
      cohorts_stats <- cohorts_stats %>%
                       left_join(percentage_fc_increase,by = c("Parameter"))
    
    # Order Parameters
      list_parameter_groups <- read.xlsx(file.path(basedir,"data", "Grouping of Luminex Marker.xlsx"))
      cohorts_stats$Parameter <- factor(cohorts_stats$Parameter, levels = list_parameter_groups$Parameter)
      
# Create the Bubble Plot
    bubble_plot <- ggplot(cohorts_stats, aes(x = Parameter, y = Group, 
                                             size = abs(percentage_fc_1.5),
                                             color = log2_fc)) + 
                    geom_point(alpha = 1) + 
                    scale_size(range = c(2, 9)) +
                    scale_color_gradient2(mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
                    labs(title = "Fold Change (Log2) by Parameter of CarTrans patients vs Healthy",
                         x = "Parameter", y = "Group", 
                         size = "Percentage of Patients (FC > 1.5)", color = "Log2 Fold Change") +
                    theme_minimal() +
                    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), 
                          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14))  

# Display the plot
  print(bubble_plot)
```


```{r abundance bubble plot each visit, fig.height=15, fig.width=15}
# Prepare data table for bubble plot
  # Create the loop vector
    parameters <- names(which(sapply(table_lum_CarTrans_overall, is.numeric) == TRUE)) 
    
  # Prepare data table 
    table_para <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
                  mutate(Visit = case_when(Visit == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
                                           Visit == "V0" ~ "Baseline",
                                           Visit == "V1" ~ "Week 1",
                                           Visit == "V2" ~ "Week 2",
                                           Visit == "V3" ~ "Month 1-3",
                                           Visit == "V4" ~ "Month 4-6",
                                           Visit == "V5" ~ "Month 12",
                                           grepl("^VX", Visit) ~ "Rejection Context",
                                            TRUE ~ as.character(Visit))) %>%
                  pivot_longer(cols = where(is.numeric),
                               names_to = "Parameter",
                               values_to = "Parameter_val")
    
# Calculate mean expression for the healthy participants
  healthy_stats <- table_para %>%
                   filter(Visit == "Healthy") %>%
                   group_by(Parameter) %>%
                   summarise(mean_expr_healthy = mean(Parameter_val, na.rm = TRUE))

# Calculate mean expression for CarTrans cohort & calcuate FC
  cohorts_stats <- table_para %>%
                   filter(Visit != "Healthy") %>%
                   group_by(Visit, Parameter) %>%
                   summarise(mean_expr_visits = mean(Parameter_val, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
                   left_join(healthy_stats, by = "Parameter") %>%
                   mutate(log2_fc = log2(mean_expr_visits / mean_expr_healthy))

  
# Calculate abundance fold change > 1.5 per parameter in AM cohort
  percentage_fc_increase <- table_para %>%
                            filter(Visit != "Healthy") %>%
                            group_by(Visit, Parameter) %>%
                            left_join(healthy_stats, by = "Parameter") %>%
                            mutate(log2_fc = log2(Parameter_val / mean_expr_healthy)) %>%
                            mutate(fc_1.5 = log2_fc >1.5) %>%
                            summarise(percentage_fc_1.5 = mean(fc_1.5, na.rm = TRUE) * 100)
  
    # Merge stats tables
      cohorts_stats <- cohorts_stats %>%
                       left_join(percentage_fc_increase,by = c("Visit", "Parameter"))
    
    # Reorder Cohorts order
      cohorts_stats <-  cohorts_stats %>%
                        mutate(Visit = factor(Visit, levels = c("Healthy", "Baseline","Week 1", "Week 2", "Month 1-3", "Month 4-6", "Month 12", "Rejection Context")))
    
    # Order Parameters
      list_parameter_groups <- read.xlsx(file.path(basedir,"data", "Grouping of Luminex Marker.xlsx"))
      cohorts_stats$Parameter <- factor(cohorts_stats$Parameter, levels = list_parameter_groups$Parameter)
      
# Create the Bubble Plot
    bubble_plot <- ggplot(cohorts_stats, aes(x = Parameter, y = Visit, 
                                             size = abs(percentage_fc_1.5),
                                             color = log2_fc)) + 
                    geom_point(alpha = 1) + 
                    scale_size(range = c(2, 8)) +
                    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(cohorts_stats$Visit))) +
                    scale_color_gradient2(mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0) +
                    labs(title = "Fold Change (Log2) by Parameter and Visit",
                         x = "Parameter", y = "Visit", 
                         size = "Percentage of Patients (FC > 1.5)", color = "Log2 Fold Change") +
                    theme_minimal() +
                    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 16), 
                          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15))  

# Display the plot
  print(bubble_plot)
```

## Combined volcano plot
```{r combined volcano plot of healthy vs CarTrans}
#  Set rownames
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  select(-Class_Sup, -Transplantation_risk)
  
# Rename Healthy vs all CarTrans Visits
  table_lum_CarTrans_overall$Visit <- ifelse(table_lum_CarTrans_overall$Visit == "Healthy", "Healthy", "CarTrans")

# Calculate p-values between CarTrans and healthy
    
  # Create the loop.vector (all the parameter columns)
    names(which(sapply(table_lum_CarTrans_overall, is.numeric) == TRUE)) -> parameters 

  # Create table for stats
    table_lum_CarTrans_overall_stat <- data.table (Parameter = numeric(), group1 = character(), 
                                              group2 = character(), n1 = numeric(),
                                              n2 = numeric(), statistic = numeric (),
                                              p = numeric (), p.signif = character(), FDR = numeric()) #FDR False Discovery Rate
   
  # Create loop for calculation of stat test by parameter between CarTrans and healthy cohort
    for (i in parameters)
      
    { 
      # Formula to insert parameter in loop 
        formula = as.formula( paste(i, "Visit", sep="~") )
          
        stat_parameter <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>% 
                          wilcox_test(formula = formula) %>%
                          add_significance() %>%
                          mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>% #Benjamini-Hochberg correction
                          rename(Parameter = .y.)
        
      # Combine currently calculated stats with previous calculations
        table_lum_CarTrans_overall_stat <- rbind(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_stat, stat_parameter)
    }

# Calculate FC between different Visits
    
      # Calculate Mean of parameters per group
        table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2  <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>% 
                                       group_by(Visit) %>%
                                       summarise(across(CCL11:BMP4, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)))
      
      # Transverse Data Table and set rownames
        table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t  <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2  %>% 
                                         t %>% 
                                         as.data.frame() %>% 
                                         row_to_names(1)
     
     # Convert whole data table to numeric
       table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t  <- mutate_all(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t, 
                                                   function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
       
     # Calculate FC between healthy and CarTrans
       table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t$log2_fc <- log2(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t$CarTrans /
                                                    table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t$Healthy)
       
     # Add p-values to data table
        # Extract only Parameters and p-values
           stat.test_p <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall_stat %>% 
                          dplyr::select(Parameter, FDR)

        # Merge data tables (log2, FC, p val)
          table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t$Parameter <- rownames(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t)
          table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano <- merge(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_log2_t, stat.test_p, by = "Parameter")
 
  # Create Volcano Plot
          
     # Mark parameters if FC > 1.5 = upregulated
       table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano$diff_expression <- ifelse (table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano$log2_fc > 1.5, 
                                                                "up", "no")
     
     # Add new column to relabel parameters FC of > 1.5
      table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano$label_para <- ifelse (table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano$log2_fc > 1.5, 
                                                          table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano$Parameter, "")    
    
      plot_volcano <- EnhancedVolcano(table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano, 
                                      lab = table_lum_CarTrans_overall_volcano$label_para,
                                      x = 'log2_fc', y = 'FDR', 
                                      FCcutoff = 1.5, pointSize = 3.5, labSize = 4, colAlpha = 0.7,
                                      boxedLabels = TRUE, col = c("grey", "grey", "grey", "darkred"),   
                                      xlab = bquote(~Log[2]~ "fold change"), ylab = bquote("FDR-adjusted p-value"),
                                      xlim = c(0, 4.5), ylim = c(0, 4), pCutoff = 0.05,
                                      title = NULL, subtitle = NULL, border = 'full',
                                      drawConnectors = TRUE,widthConnectors = 0.5, colConnectors = "darkred") +
                                      theme_classic() +
                                      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
                                            panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,),
                                            legend.position = "none")
      
      print( plot_volcano)
```
